name: Sonarr
description: Finds new episodes of your series, and files them in your library.
notes: The first visit asks you to choose how to sign in. Under Settings → Download Clients, add qBittorrent or SABnzbd by the server's LAN address and port; Prowlarr fills in the indexers. Add /data/media/series as the root folder. Give every download app the same Media and downloads folder, with downloads in /data/downloads and your library in /data/media, so finished files move into the library without being copied. The folder must belong to the apps' user (or set APPS_MEDIA_UID and APPS_MEDIA_GID to its owner); point Jellyfin at the library inside it.
